Your cloud Job Loop

Saving a career record is an explicit choice. Its source text, target preferences, confirmed facts, vacancies, run reports and prepared documents are stored in your private Supabase account. Unsaved career record, claim and new-vacancy edits can be recovered during in-app navigation from this tab’s memory for up to thirty minutes. They are not written to browser storage, and refresh, closing the tab, sign-out or switching accounts clears them. Sharing and factual confirmations need review again after recovery. Runs use a saved version of your record. A correction or withdrawal requires a new review before a packet can be downloaded again; it cannot recall a file already downloaded.

Optional models and search

The free CV check and existing preparation packs do not call external AI. In the cloud loop, you can choose the available rules mode or consent to the selected Claude, OpenAI or Kimi provider for that run. The model receives confirmed facts you marked shareable and vacancy text, rather than the entire raw source CV. Job search queries use target roles and locations. Availability depends on the configured accounts. Remove confidential or unnecessary sensitive information before saving or sharing.

Optional inbox access

Signing in with Google does not connect your inbox. Connecting Gmail requires a separate Google permission screen. When configured, the loop can read relevant job-search messages and store selected summaries. Draft access is optional; creating a draft requires your approval of its recipient and attachment. Jobvance has no email-send or application-submit action. Disconnecting removes its stored connection credentials; it does not delete messages or drafts already in Gmail. Google permissions can also be revoked in your Google account.

Document access

Approved documents are retained for your access after pack expiry. Public examples use fictional data. Contact and service availability.

The free check

The six-step check and its reviewed downloads are free and do not use preparation-pack credits. Evidence findings are comparisons of supplied English text. They do not verify qualifications, establish eligibility or predict screening results.

The information you provide

Provide information you have the right to use. Check and approve the wording before downloading or submitting. Do not invent qualifications, experience or achievements.

Proposed subscription tiers

Focus at $15 per month and Job Loop at $29 per month are proposed future tiers, not offers for sale. Their displayed pack and run limits are proposals. The ten-account pilot remains free, without a card or automatic paid conversion. Final entitlements, cancellation and commercial terms must be confirmed before checkout opens.

Application preparation and tracking

Jobvance provides application preparation and tracking. It does not promise interviews, employment, recruiter access or automated submission. Employer decisions are outside the service’s control.

Cloud loop availability

The pilot is free and subject to run limits and service availability. The rules mode uses confirmed facts. External models, search and inbox access require their respective configuration and consent. Reports identify unavailable or incomplete stages. A relevance score explains this tool’s comparison; it is not an ATS score or a prediction of hiring. Recurring preparation requires your explicit opt-in and a configured scheduler. The workspace reports the actual next run and execution history. Pause or cancel a schedule there; cancelling a schedule is separate from cancelling an already running job.

Current availability

These product terms describe the current workflow. Real-money checkout remains disabled. Jobvance is currently a free beta; the proposed subscription tiers are not offered for sale.

; return

Failed requests and credits

A failed request that does not save a usable pack should not consume a credit. Retry the same request after resolving the error. Previously approved packs can be downloaded again without another credit.

Incorrect charges or unusable paid access

For incorrect charges, duplicate purchases or unusable paid access, use the published support contact with your receipt reference. Confirmed refunds revoke unused credits from the relevant purchase and do not erase documents already downloaded.

Before paid access launches

The operator must confirm the final refund window before real-money checkout is enabled. No interview or employment guarantee is offered.
